lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council work session, where the Comp Plan, the Gondola Subcommittee, and — most critically — a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies all get air time; that housing audit question touches something fundamental about who can actually afford to live here, so it's worth paying attention to. Alongside that, the Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up the Martin exception request Wednesday, a real-stakes decision about whether deed-restricted homeowners can get roof repairs approved. The week also brings the Wilkinson Library's Youth Area grand opening Wednesday and a drone show Thursday.

notable.stake: Third-party rental housing audit review could shape who stays in the canyon.
Vote on whether deed-restricted homeowners can approve a $47K roof repair.
